notes: Abu Jamra asked Ibn Abbas (rule 5); Ibn Abbas's words («الله أكبر سنة أبي القاسم») are the saying, so he is the last link. The dream is part of Abu Jamra's narrative, not a second isnad.
«قال وقال آدم ووهب بن جرير وغندر عن شعبة» names other transmitters of the same words from شعبة: a variant group, never a route.
